symptom: numeric flag received a quoted pair, parser silently fell back to default
looked_valid: 25 artifacts written, exit codes zero, plausibly distributed results
actually: all 25 runs were the identical default configuration; a pre-registered series measured nothing
countermeasure: fail fast on unparsable flag values with the received value in the error

symptom: pull request pushed, zero workflow runs appeared
looked_valid: no failures, no queue, apparent calm
actually: merge-ref conflict: CI cannot build a merge ref, so it silently runs nothing; PR was stalled for two weeks
countermeasure: monitor run presence, not only run color; zero runs after a push is a page-able signal

symptom: held-out report scored the visible set against the wrong schedule
looked_valid: 5/5 unit tests green including a determinism test; mutation gate green
actually: tests verified the computation performed, not the semantics claimed; a cold independent agent found it in 13 minutes; 41 mutation sites all uncovered due to a missing coverage hand-off
countermeasure: independent cold re-reading of metric semantics; wire the mutation gate before trusting it

symptom: obvious workspace test command reports green or fails to compile program tests
looked_valid: a green cargo test run on rules-only crates
actually: program tests embed an SBF artifact and are excluded; four cold agents hit variants, one run lost its report entirely
countermeasure: one command that runs the real check set and prints what it did not cover

symptom: replay panel rendered 'attempt unavailable' for an unknown state
looked_valid: a definite, readable status for the user
actually: the data layer honestly nulled unknown fields; the view collapsed null into a confident negative

symptom: paired run added market context to the focal agent's prompt; every saved request and response stayed bit-identical across arms
looked_valid: a fully valid paired experiment with exact replay and settlement
actually: the agent completely ignored the added information; decisions were insensitive to context, and the pipeline had no signal for that
countermeasure: bit-comparison of requests/responses across information arms as a cheap context-sensitivity gate; a decision loop that cannot change its answer cannot be using its context

symptom: round-one market menus contained only pass; the model deterministically answered an invented produce_goods action
looked_valid: provider returned HTTP 200 with well-formed JSON on every call
actually: 0 of 100 calls copied a menu object; the run stopped at the preregistered failure threshold before a single accepted action; direct probes show compliance on richer menus, so the failure is specific to menus without the action the model wants
countermeasure: measure protocol compliance on the poorest legal menu before spending budget; a smoke run of the first mandatory move is one call

symptom: between-arm concentration compared at very different bribe volumes
looked_valid: the legal attacker showed lower recipient HHI than the uniform arm on 18 of 20 paired seeds
actually: the attacker bribes about four times more often, and concentration metrics shrink mechanically with volume; the conditional within-game permutation test flags the same games at p 0.00-0.02
countermeasure: condition on the recorded offer sets and compare at matched volume; never compare concentration across arms with different activity levels

symptom: an attacker policy aimed at the richest visible peer kept answering legally after opponent cash was hidden
looked_valid: all answers stayed inside the legal menu; the game completed cleanly on every seed
actually: with the single cash channel zeroed the chosen targets fell to the center of the true wealth distribution (midrank percentile 0.49-0.50) and the concentration breach vanished: the aim lived entirely in the observation, not the offer structure
countermeasure: ablate the information channel an attacker is assumed to read; a preregistered blinded control turns an assumption into a measurement
